operations.label: Dissolve cadmium nitrate in 15 mL oleylamine at 140 °C
operations.description: Three-neck flask. Clear solution is the reported complex-formation endpoint; heating duration and exact dissolved complex are not given. Main PDF p.2 §2.1 prints 1 mM of cadmium nitrate is taken. Concentration is written as an amount; total moles/mass and hydration state are unresolved. No correction to 1 mmol.

operations.label: Raise reaction temperature to 240 °C
operations.description: As soon as the selected reaction temperature is reached, begin H2S introduction. No ramp rate or stabilization dwell supplied.

operations.label: Pass H2S for 10 min at 240 °C
operations.description: H2S feed begins at target temperature. Gas flow and delivered amount are not reported; kinetic discussion does not define a separate measured nucleation duration.

operations.label: Stop reaction by removing flask from heating mantle
operations.description: Physical removal from mantle is the reported termination. No quench solvent or cooling bath invented.

operations.label: Cool to 100 °C
operations.description: Cooling method and rate are unreported. Workup atmosphere not separately restated.

operations.label: Add chloroform after cooling to 100 °C
operations.description: Requisite amount of chloroform to remove unreacted oleylamine; quantity unreported.

operations.label: Add ethanol to precipitate yellow product
operations.description: Add ethanol to precipitate yellow product

operations.label: Centrifuge five times at 6000 rpm for 5 min each
operations.description: Recover yellow powder/precipitated solids. Between-cycle wash and redispersion details are not stated. No rotor-radius-to-RCF conversion.

operations.label: Dry cleaned powder under vacuum at 70 °C
operations.description: Drying time and vacuum pressure are not reported.

operations.label: Acquire TEM, HRTEM and SAED
operations.description: JEOL200kV FETEM; Digital Micrograph. Grid preparation, dilution and dose unreported.

operations.label: Grind powder and load grooved quartz-glass plate
operations.description: Well-ground powder loaded for Bragg–Brentano geometry; sample mass and grinding method unreported.

operations.label: Acquire laboratory powder XRD
operations.description: Philips X Pert Pro CuKα. Angular units are not silently added to the printed step and rate.

operations.label: Acquire synchrotron powder XRD
operations.description: BL18B Indian beamline at Photon Factory KEK; Bragg–Brentano geometry. Dwell adjusted for signal-to-noise, no numeric dwell. Main PDF p.2 §2.2 states 14 keV and λ=1.0287 Å; Figure2 also states λ=1.0287 Å. These are inconsistent energy/wavelength values, retained without choosing a replacement.

operations.label: Acquire powder absorption and PL spectra
operations.description: Lambda35 UV–vis and PerkinElmer LS55 PL. Source does not give a universal excitation wavelength or powder optical specimen preparation.

notes: Selected temperature is explicit. Common preparation/workup is inherited by the200/240 °C repetitions; no physical batch ID.

quality.review_scope: All 9 main and 5 SI pages read in text and actual page images. Three CdS liquid–gas synthesis temperatures, gas generation, TiO2/FTO support preparation, three CdS sensitizations, three CdSe co-sensitizations, separately qualified ZnS passivation, electrolyte and cathode support, and six photovoltaic devices. Measurement contexts preserve source sample labels but do not invent exact physical batch identity. Source ambiguities and incomplete protocols remain explicit. No external cited procedure is reconstructed.
